questions.answer: I think it was easy, i used my network - but COHABS can be a recommendation as a last option.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Transportation is expensive if you are over 26

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Dont know anything about it

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The course selection process is very late and confusing - you do not know what courses you are going to take if there will be any changes so that you can't change them - all of this makes the completion of OLA seem impossible and very stressful

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You enroll in every course you are interested in - in the first weeks you attend all lectures and then you double check the timetable, the requirements and then you choose your courses to be finalized in october.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Guidance from international coordinator

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not very, since the systems don't work the same way I had to take six courses, and other non-exchange students had 3 to 4, whereas not all of them were with examinations. I had to end up having courses that overlapped with their time schedule or having days with over 9 hours of lectures. That is not sustainable

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Dont choose the courses you find most interesting choose at least half of the courses as the ones you think you can pass more easily

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) Dont live in Leuven if you get bored 
2) Live in Leuven if you get easily distracted 
3) Try to make it easy for yourself, it is a lot of pressure

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Remember to double check course information right up until deadline

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting other passionate people and a change of environment

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The amount of courses

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: You should honestly consider if you are able to do it with the amount of courses, it feels very intense and extreme. This is not an exchange for meeting new cultures and getting new friends; it's for the univeristy and studies.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
